usedFor: CTM tracks calls and Microsoft Excel keeps the log, with “Call Ends” adding a line through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “Call Ends” in CTM, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: A finished call becomes a row once it ends, so the call log fills itself.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” writes into an Excel table, so set up that table before the first call ends.
